messages:
alexa: Quick heads-up — onboarding Sapphire-7B. Initial eval shows subtle token drift on long-context runs, looks like a RoPE/phase mismatch when we hit >1k tokens.
pranav: Can you paste the minimal repro? model repo + config we used? :eyes:
alexa: reproducer below, running our runtime (v1.14) vs HF fp16 checkpoint. Notice the cross-attn alignment diverges after ~1200 tokens.
```python
# reproducer (local)
from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoTokenizer
model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained('sapphire-7b', torch_dtype=torch.float16)
tok = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('sapphire-7b')
seq = ' '.join(['word']*1300)
inputs = tok(seq, return_tensors='pt')
out = model.generate(**inputs, max_new_tokens=1, do_sample=False)
print(tok.decode(out[0]))
```
jamie: ran same input through quantized path (int8) — probs look similar until drift, then output repeats a short phrase. could be kv rotation mismatch + qerror amplification.
ingrid: we should check rotary base/scale. Some vendors store explicit phase_offset or use different freq base. Did we do the freq table mapping?
pranav: not for this checkpoint; we assumed canonical RoPE with inv_freq = 10000 ** (2i/d). I'll try a phase_offset knob patch in runtime to test.
alexa: also observed that when we warm KV cache across segments the cached keys seem to shift by a constant phase. Patch might need to apply a circular shift to cached K/V positions.
pranav: quick experiment: adding a phase correction factor in the rotary projection. patch snippet:
```c++
// runtime rotary projection tweak
float phase_offset = cfg.get("rope_phase_offset", 0.0f);
q = apply_rope(q, pos, phase_offset);
k = apply_rope(k, pos, phase_offset);
```
pranav: running smoke now with phase_offset = -0.00035 and with kv-rebase enabled.
ci-bot: smoke-run: sapphire-7b / rope-phase-smoke / job-44912 -> PASSED (latency 92ms p50), outputs matched baseline up to 2048 tokens for 95% of samples.
alexa: nice. can we add a synthetic KV continuity test: append two segments with overlapping token count and assert logits continuity?
ingrid: yes, something like feed segment A (1024), then B (512) and compare logits for the overlap window at B start. If mismatch > epsilon flag fail. i'll draft the test.
jamie: also logging the quantization delta per token would help isolate amplification points. suggest per-head L2 diff and per-token perplexity delta. small tooling change.
pranav: plan: 1) add config knob rope_phase_offset and kv_rebase flag to runtime; 2) run sweep phase_offset in [-0.001,0.001] coarse then fine; 3) run int8 quantized runs with that best offset; 4) add KV continuity synthetic tests to CI.
alexa: prioritization wise, make this P0 for Sapphire-7B onboarding since customers expect stable long-context. assign to eng-ml rotation.
ingrid: I'll open a short PR with tests + ci job. tagging @pranav for runtime change and @jamie for quant metrics.
pranav: picking this up now. will post logs in this thread.
ci-bot: deploy-bot: created ephemeral job sapphire-phase-sweep-17854321. logs will appear in the pipeline.
jamie: optional: also check for rotary sin/cos numerical precision across fp16 vs int8 kernels; some kernels precompute scaled sin/cos which can drift.
alexa: agreed. let's avoid heuristic fixes until we validate. small, auditable-phase-correction is fine as short-term.
pranav: update: coarse sweep done, best offset found -0.00037 reduces mismatch from 12%->1.4% at 2048 tokens. pushing branch now.
ingrid: thanks — putting a note in onboarding doc about potential phase offset for Sapphire family. will add a checklist item: "rotary phase sanity + KV continuity".
alexa: perfect. follow-ups: add example reproducer to docs, record sweep artifact, and schedule a longer run overnight for int8 quantization. :white_check_mark:
